description.en: LPG connection support for an adult woman from an eligible poor household that does not already have an Oil Marketing Company LPG connection in the household.

benefit_summary.en: An approved beneficiary receives a security-deposit-free LPG connection and the connection assistance specified by the current scheme. Refill prices, subsidies, and additional items must be checked against the current portal and distributor terms.

eligibility_summary.en: The applicant must be a woman aged 18 or older, belong to a poor household under the prescribed deprivation declaration, and have no other Oil Marketing Company LPG connection in the same household.

prompt.en: What is the applicant's age in completed years?
Can the applicant submit the prescribed poor-household deprivation declaration?
Does anyone in the household already have an LPG connection from an Oil Marketing Company?
Does the applicant's Aadhaar show the current address?

description.en: The applicant is at least 18 years old.
The applicant can submit the prescribed poor-household declaration.
The household already has an Oil Marketing Company LPG connection.

name.en: Current address proof or migrant self-declaration

notes.en: Needed when the Aadhaar address differs from the current address.

name.en: Ration card, state family-composition document, or permitted migrant self-declaration
Aadhaar copies of adult family members listed in the family document
Bank passbook copy or cancelled cheque

instruction.en: Prepare the current KYC form, deprivation declaration, and supporting documents.
Apply through an authorised LPG distributor or the official online application channel.
Confirm approval and all charges directly with the distributor before receiving the connection.
